name: Holo Hub
summary: Docker Hub, streamable. Browse all 13M images with their real artwork, then stream any of them live in your tab on the holospaces runtime — 100% serverless, every byte verified before it paints.

description.p: A live resolver for Docker Hub, not a mirror. The index is baked fresh from Hub's own catalog with the original artwork inlined and κ-sealed, so the whole browse experience ships in the app: instant search across every category, zero network, no proxy, works in any browser.

Opening an image streams the real thing in your tab on the upstream holospaces runtime — the same wasm engine this bundle boots on. A Hologram node prepares the image once into the κ object-fabric; after that it resumes near-instantly, fault-lazy, for you and anyone you share it with. Every κ-object re-derives to its hash before use (Law L5).
Golden-ratio layout, artwork-derived colour per card, a cinematic spotlight from the most-pulled feed. Built for people and AI agents alike on the open semantic web.
